description: Capabilities and environmental limitations. May be edited without changing scenario definitions.

ipv6.reason: No native public IPv6 route on host or VM

packet_capture.reason: Optional; enable when capture tooling is prepared

udp_fragmentation.reason: 65507-byte UDP requires an explicitly prepared fragmentation path

product_live_rule_update.reason: The current product CLI publishes no atomic live-rule update and exact readback contract

product_profile_readback.reason: The current product CLI publishes no active-rule readback contract

failure_injection.reason: Controlled TestLab-owned DNS, receive-only and client-process termination injectors are available

control_failure_injection.reason: Only allowlisted TestLab-owned bounded injectors with cleanup proof are enabled

protocol_worker.reason: Selected real runs additionally require the verified bundled runtime readiness gate

server_python_protocols.reason: Installed and verified by the TestLab server provisioning receipt

server_tls_pki.reason: Generated and provisioned automatically by TestLab; no manual certificate field is required

server_http2.reason: Installed and verified by the TestLab endpoint receipt

server_quic.reason: Installed from the pinned offline QUIC dependency bundle and verified by the endpoint receipt

server_file_transfer.reason: Installed and verified by the TestLab endpoint receipt

server_mail.reason: Installed and verified by the TestLab endpoint receipt

server_messaging.reason: Installed and verified by the TestLab endpoint receipt

protocol_sftp.reason: SFTP remains gated until a pinned SSH host-key and SFTP subsystem test contract is implemented

server_realtime.reason: Controlled STUN, TURN and SRTP endpoint transactions are installed and verified by the endpoint receipt

local_browser_runtime.reason: Derived automatically per run after an allowlisted browser image, version and integrity check; no manual browser path is accepted

server_browser_origin.reason: Requires a fresh server provisioning receipt for the controlled browser origin

server_webrtc_peer.reason: No receipt-verified remote RTCPeerConnection peer is installed

synthetic_media_capture.reason: Requires the real-browser deterministic media-track contract; this does not represent interactive desktop capture

isolated_proxy_negative_target.reason: Requires a run-owned negative SOCKS endpoint and principal receipt; operator proxy settings are never reused

endpoint_restart_control.reason: Requires a receipt-bound allowlisted endpoint restart helper with invocation and rollback proof

local_performance_worker.reason: Requires the bundled native performance worker to pass integrity, architecture and calibration self-tests

server_performance_origin.reason: Requires a fresh endpoint receipt for workload-correlated performance interval evidence

server_metrics.reason: Point-in-time SSH diagnostics are not a workload-correlated monotonic metric window

local_product_metrics.reason: Requires exact local ProxyBridge process identity and synchronized resource sampling privileges
